content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen works: photo, headline and one CTA fit, but the contact details repeat three times down the page (header strip, info block, footer block).","desktopNote":"Desktop hero wastes the right half with large empty bands above and below the text, and the menu list sits in a half-width column leaving the whole right side of the section blank.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Desktop: tighten the hero to the photo height and fill the right half (vertically centre text, add hours/address under the CTA); make the menu two columns or add the oven photo beside it instead of leaving half the width empty.","Merge the repeated contact blocks: keep the header phone/directions strip, one info block after the hero, and reduce the footer to legal data only; drop the phone number and directions link from the footer.","Scale down the giant '2015' so it does not outweigh the pizzeria headline, and give the menu categories dish photos or a wood-oven detail to make the page feel like this pizzeria rather than a typographic template."],"blockers":["Desktop: the hero and the 'Pečemo na drva' section leave large dead bands of empty space, and the menu section's right half is blank — the layout looks unfinished on desktop.","Phone: phone number, address and directions link are repeated in the header strip, the info block and the footer; the 'Obiščite nas'/'Delovni čas' block repeats the earlier info block."]}
